title: A Lantern for the Clock
author: Yara Oyelaran
blurb: Orsen Thornbury, a battlefield nurse keeping a ledger of the names officers omit, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
